about.title: About me
about.content: I am currently pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Radharaman Institute of Technology & Science, Bhopal. My journey in this field has equipped me with a basic foundation in C programming and Python . Currently,my focus is on web development , where I am honing my skills in HTML, CSS, PHP,and MySQL . I believe in learning by doing, and my portfolio is a testament to this approach.
